title: Austin's Future: Transit, Budget, Airport
summary:
*   **State Transportation Policy**: Adopted a resolution addressing state-level transportation issues.
*   **Future Airport Upgrades**: Scheduled a report presentation to discuss interim airport improvements.
*   **City Growth and Budget**: Officials reviewed the operational budget and departments focused on managing urban growth, including planning and building inspection.
*   **Environmental Discussion Delayed**: Postponed a planned discussion on environmental protection.

TRANSPORTATION ISSUES
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Humphrey's second,
adopted a resolution regarding transportation issues which were before the Texas
Legislature during Special Session. (4-0 Vote, Councilmembers Shipman and Urdy and Mayor
Pro Tem Trevino absent.)
INTERIM AIRPORT IMPROVEMENTS REPORT
The Council, by unanimous consent, set the date of September 16, 1986 at 4:00p.m. for
presentation of the
Interim Airport Improvements Report.
WORK SESSION
Council had a work session on the operations budget and discussed Growth Services
departments of Building Inspection, OLDS, and Planning and Growth Management.
Postponed at the City Manager's request, was discussion of Environmental Protection.
ADJOURNMENT
The meeting was adjourned at 6:20 p.m.
